articles.title: CVS will split up its pharmacy and insurance business into two companies, WSJ says
articles.summary: Nov 3 (Reuters) - CVS Health plans to break up its $117 billion business, separating its retail pharmacies from the Caremark pharmacy benefit management operations and the Aetna insurance company it bought nearly a decade ago, the Wall Street Journal quoted the company as saying on Tuesday. CVS Health, which is set to report quarterly results on ‌Wednesday, did not respond to a Reuters request for comment.
